BmsHistoryFlags.description: Four adjacent state bytes of the status-history ring control block at 0x20000568. Written by bms_status_event_snapshot and bms_history_ring_commit; the ring buffer itself lies at 0x200010A8 to 0x200012FC.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: Snapshot pending flag (0x20000568): 1 while a status snapshot waits in the slot at 0x200010A8. Set by bms_status_event_snapshot, cleared after five commits by bms_history_ring_commit.

fields.name: ring_ready
fields.description: Ring-initialised flag (0x20000569): 0 until the first bms_history_ring_commit call fills the ten 64-byte records, then 1.

fields.name: commit_count
fields.description: Commit counter (0x2000056A): counts bms_history_ring_commit calls while a snapshot is pending; reset to 0 when the snapshot is handed to bms_slot_pool_register.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Mirror of status bits (0x2000056B): bits 0 and 1 form the two-bit state for the 0x124 bit 2 condition; bits 2 to 7 mirror bits 4, 3, 7 to 10 and 12, 5 and 6, 13 and 14, and 0x126 bits 4, 7, 8 and 12 of the state block.
